title: HDFC Bank Ltd — Updates
text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Grant of stock options under Employees Stock Option Scheme 2024 and Grant of Restricted Stock Units under Employees Stock Incentive Master Scheme 2022'.
